description:
Fluent keeps your closet organized in ChatGPT: the clothes you own, with photos, so ChatGPT can help you decide what to wear and whether something new is worth buying.

Add clothes quickly from photos, product links, or a simple list, then browse them in an interactive wardrobe. Ask for an outfit from what you already own, or share something you're considering and ChatGPT compares it with the clothes you have. You choose what to save, and you can correct, export, or delete it at any time.

defaultPrompt: Help me add my clothes to Fluent.
What should I wear today from my Fluent closet?
